reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets users select local skills and automatically injects their content into each prompt or at session start, with persistent settings and a composer status indicator.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供技能注入功能，允许用户选择本地技能并将其自动加入每轮提示或会话开始消息中。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for selecting local skills and automatically injecting them into every prompt or into the session-start message.

capabilities: Reads selected skill content from the local skill registry
Injects selected skills into agent prompts or session-start messages
Stores user-selected skills and injection mode in plugin settings
Provides a settings page, composer indicator, and local status API
